output.reason: The brief makes a sound case that interim cycle-count estimates (±0.6 pts, frequently not confirmed historically) can't yet show a real trend, and that the shoplifting-log rise reflects the new incident app; its recommendation to keep the 7 December count and hold other actions is clear, though it gives little guidance on what to do for each possible count result.
